title: A few ordinary subagents
summary: The main conversation coordinates a few independent assignments.
useWhen: A few small tasks have separate evidence or ownership.
Saving a script provides no useful reuse.
avoidWhen: Many intermediate results overwhelm conversational coordination.
Assignments depend on shared mutable state.
contract: Give each worker a self-contained brief and acceptance.
The main agent reconciles all assignments and integrates.
example: Check two unrelated configuration files against their official documentation.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  M[Main agent] --> A[Config reader A]
  M --> B[Config reader B]
  A --> I[Main integration]
  B --> I
  I --> V[Acceptance]
